raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The DE-412 change added the filter `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 hours` to silver_transactions. The source routinely delivers valid POSTED transactions up to about 3 days late (e.g. batch 11 has txn_ts 2026-01-13 with ingest 2026-01-16), and txn_id is fully unique, so the filter does not remove duplicates or bad records. It silently drops legitimate late-arriving transactions from every batch from 3 onward, which also undercounts all gold aggregates. Removing the lag filter while keeping the status = 'POSTED' rule restores the correct silver and gold data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
